figures.title: Chapter map
figures.why: the whole chapter is one idea read at three scales — phase, film, aperture
figures.data: the 12-part structure (Huygens → double slit → films → interferometers → diffraction → polarisation → coherence → instruments → playbook → paper)
figures.read: after part 1 everything is a path difference converted to phase; each setup changes only what 'path' means

figures.title: The phase-difference recipe
figures.why: every interference number is the same three moves in the same order; the flow fixes the order so λ/2 cannot be added at the wrong time
figures.data: geometric Δx → optical Σnᵢxᵢ → add λ/2 per reflection off a denser medium → compare with nλ / (2n+1)λ/2
figures.read: preserve the order — the reflection phase can only be added after you know which paths reflect

figures.title: Fringe width β = λD/d — one knob per quantity
figures.why: one formula, three separate memories; the flow pins each knob to its effect
figures.data: β = λD/d: β ∝ λ, β ∝ D, β ∝ 1/d; immersed apparatus β/μ; brightness changes nothing
figures.read: geometry and wavelength set the spacing; brightness sets only the visibility

figures.title: The phase-change rule: denser flips, rarer does not
figures.why: one lost λ/2 is the commonest error; the rule is two cases
figures.data: n₁<n₂ → reflected wave gains π; n₁>n₂ → no change; transmission never changes phase
figures.read: the flip belongs to one specific reflected beam — mark a cross at each denser-boundary reflection

figures.title: Intensity: two coherent waves give four, never two
figures.why: coherent waves add amplitudes, incoherent sources add intensities; name which before touching numbers
figures.data: coherent equal sources I = 4I₀cos²(Δφ/2), average 2I₀; unequal slits lift minima to I₀(a₁-a₂)²
figures.read: equal coherent waves quadruple the intensity at a bright fringe; energy is moved sideways, never destroyed

figures.title: Triage — read the question, then pick the box
figures.why: the six kinds are the six equations of the subject; the keyword routes the solution
figures.data: slits→β=λD/d; film→2μt·cos r; one aperture→a sinθ=mλ (dark); grating→d sinθ=nλ; filter→Malus/Brewster; telescope→1.22λ/D
figures.read: name the kind first, then any thickness/index/wavelength is a path difference to convert into waves
